name: Eraldom
body:
From
the jagged peaks of the Wolf's Teeth Range to the depths of the North Sea, lies a world
scarred by ancient magic and forgotten dynasties. The Athenaeum records these lands as they
are, open to what they might become.

To the east, the **Boundless Vale** still
radiate with the chaotic energy of the Ophrasian War.

> "Do not trust the maps drawn before the War. The land remembers the trauma, it has been disfigured."
> — Master Sage Elara
